name: AI Red Team
description: PyRIT·SkillSpector로 LLM 탈옥·프롬프트 인젝션 등 적대적 스캔을 수행하는 AI 레드팀 에이전트입니다. 격리 네트워크와 명시적 옵트인이 필요합니다. 전용 화면이 없어 좌측 메뉴에는 표시되지 않으며, AI 어시스턴트를 통해 질의응답으로 사용합니다.
description_en: AI red-team agent using PyRIT and SkillSpector. Performs adversarial LLM scanning (jailbreak, prompt injection, data exfiltration) and agent skill evaluation. Requires an isolation network and explicit opt-in. It has no dedicated screen and does not appear in the left menu — use it via Q&A through the AI Assistant.

REDTEAM_ENABLED.description: Must be set to 'true' to activate all endpoints

REDTEAM_NETWORK.description: Must be set to 'redteam-isolated' — enforces network isolation

PYRIT_ENDPOINT.description: PyRIT service base URL for LLM adversarial scanning. If unset, mock mode is used.

PYRIT_API_KEY.description: API key for PyRIT endpoint authentication

SKILLSPECTOR_URL.description: SkillSpector service URL for agent skill evaluation. If unset, mock mode is used.

endpoints.description: Show isolation status and report count
Run LLM adversarial scan via PyRIT
Run agent skill evaluation via SkillSpector
Retrieve a single report by ID
